title: Another broadcast burn at Rocky Mountain Arsenal Wildlife Refuge
snippet: The US Fish and Wildlife Service plan on burning a little over 350 acres on Saturday at the Rocky Mountain Arsenal Wildlife Refuge in north Denver. Smoke will again be visible for surrounding areas. Smoke is expected to move from northeast to southwest once ignitions get started at approximately 10:00am MST.
